entities.name: Kallist Rhoka
entities.description: Friend of Jace Beleren and boyfriend of Liliana Vess on Ravnica, skilled with blades and illusion magic.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker mind-mage who befriended Kallist and swapped memories with him.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who dated Jace and Kallist while working for the Consortium.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Organization Kallist and Jace worked for before deserting.

entities.name: Ronia Hesset
entities.description: Skimmed money from the Consortium; her house was broken into by Kallist and Jace.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: Planeswalker whose failures were blamed on Jace.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker whose failures were blamed on Jace.

entities.name: Xalmarias
entities.description: Centaur former colleague killed by Kallist.

entities.name: Semner
entities.description: Crime boss who sought Jace and was killed by the revived Kallist.

entities.name: Lurias
entities.description: District where Jace and Kallist met Liliana.

entities.name: Favarial
entities.description: District where Jace set up an apartment and where Kallist died.

events.summary: Kallist and Jace break into Ronia Hesset's house and discover her betrayal, then agree to teach each other their skills.
events.quote: Kallist and Jace agreed to teach each other their specialties

events.summary: Jace falls out of favor with the Consortium and deserts, bringing Kallist with him.
events.quote: Jace decided to desert the consortium and brought Kallist with him

events.summary: Jace and Kallist meet Liliana in Lurias; she and Jace start dating while she secretly works for the Consortium.
events.quote: she was still working for the Consortium

events.summary: Liliana alerts the Consortium; Kallist protects Jace and kills Xalmarias.
events.quote: protecting Jace from his attackers and even killing his former colleague

events.summary: Jace tries to transfer Kallist's memories into his mind and the two end up switching memories.
events.quote: the two men ended up switching memories

events.summary: Kallist in Jace's body dates Liliana for three months and she turns down his request to be serious.
Semner's thugs take Kallist and Liliana; they kill the guards and follow Semner to Favarial.
events.quote: killed the thugs guarding them and followed Semner to the district of Favarial

events.summary: Semner stabs Jace-Kallist in the heart and kills him; Jace's mind returns to his own body.
events.quote: Jace-Kallist was stabbed in the heart and killed by Semner

events.summary: Liliana raises Kallist as undead to avenge his death and he tears out Semner's innards.
events.quote: Liliana angrily raised Kallist from the dead to avenge his death

events.summary: Liliana ends the spell and mourns until Jace returns; together they set out to avenge Kallist.
events.quote: Together, they set out to avenge his death.
